Циклофенил C23H24O4 = 364.4. CAS — 2624-43-3. ATC — G03GB01. ATC Vet — QG03GB01. Profile Cyclofenil is a nonsteroidal anti-oestrogen that has been used in the treatment of menstrual disturbances and anovulatory infertil- ity due to hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction. It has been given orally in doses of 200 mg three times daily for 5 days, in a cyclical regimen for 3 or 4 cycles. It has also been given for menopausal symptoms.
